jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Full Stack
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**


At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise\-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And, over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.

***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.***

 **Job Description**  

At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software designed to eliminate friction and reduce business complexity. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer (IC2\), you will be a key builder turning this vision into high\-performance software—developing robust backend components and responsive frontend layers that deliver exceptional customer and employee experiences at scale.

**Impact You Can Create**

* **Eliminate Enterprise Complexity:** Demolish the crushing cost and complexity of legacy systems by writing clean, modular, and intentionally simple full\-stack code.
* **Drive Frictionless Support:** Implement people\-first AI features and optimized workflows that empower nearly 75,000 global companies to lower their cost\-to\-serve and deliver faster, more human support.
* **Build for Global Trust:** Develop and scale enterprise\-grade CX and IT solution components that handle millions of transactions flawlessly for global brands like Bridgestone, Sony Music, and New Balance.

**Roles \& Responsibilities (R\&R)**

* **Full\-Stack Execution:** Build, optimize, and maintain robust backend microservices, database schemas, and highly interactive frontend application interfaces.
* **Feature Ownership:** Take end\-to\-end ownership of product feature delivery—from initial requirement analysis and technical design to automated deployment, monitoring, and production support.
* **Code Quality \& Craftsmanship:** Write clean, highly extensible, and well\-tested code rooted in solid Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts and SOLID design principles.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and SRE teams to convert product requirements into high\-value platform features quickly.
* **Production Health:** Help maintain system metrics for high availability, multi\-tenant fault tolerance, security compliance, and comprehensive infrastructure observability.
* **Performance Tuning:** Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack, from slow database queries to client\-side page rendering latencies.
* **Peer Collaboration:** Actively participate in constructive code reviews, share technical knowledge, and help maintain high engineering standards within the team.

 **Qualifications** **Skills**

* **Full\-Stack Competency:** Strong technical fluency across backend technologies (REST APIs, microservices, caching layers) and modern frontend development frameworks.
* **Core CS Foundations:** Strong expertise in Data Structures, Algorithms (DSA), and analyzing time/space complexity trade\-offs.
* **System Design Aptitude:** Proven capability in Low\-Level Design (LLD) and solid exposure to High\-Level Design (HLD) for scalable, fault\-tolerant systems.
* **Data Modeling:** Practical experience designing database schemas and working with distributed storage layers (RDBMS, NoSQL, or queuing systems).
* **AI Tool Fluency:** Practical experience utilizing AI\-assistive tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to optimize day\-to\-day coding efficiency and exploration.
* **Problem Solving \& Articulation:** Strong analytical logic with a demonstrated capability to break down complex technical problems and communicate solutions clearly.

**Qualifications**

* **Professional Timeline:** 3 to 5 years of experience building and scaling software products within fast\-paced product engineering environments.
* **Production Track Record:** A verifiable history of shipping functional SaaS features to production and supporting them through successive deployment iterations.
* **Execution Style:** A proactive self\-starter who thrives in agile teams, manages tasks effectively, and successfully balances rapid feature delivery with long\-term code health.
* **Education Baseline:** Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

 **Additional Information**  

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

* **Root\-Cause Analysis:** Troubleshoot complex full\-stack performance bottlenecks in production, from slow database queries to state\-management memory leaks.
* **Mentorship \& Best Practices:** Lead architectural reviews, establish development roadmaps, mentor 2–4 engineers, and actively drive OOPS and SOLID design principles across the org.

 **Qualifications** **Skills**

* **Computer Science Foundations:** Expert\-level grasp of Data Structures \& Algorithms (DSA), time/space complexity trade\-offs, and Object\-Oriented Design (OOD) anchored in SOLID principles.
* **System Design (HLD \& LLD):** Proven capability to design scalable, highly available, and fault\-tolerant end\-to\-end multi\-tenant systems, including APIs, web architectures, schemas, and data models.
* **Distributed Infrastructure Stack:** Solid exposure to RDBMS, NoSQL, caching strategies, microservices architecture, and distributed queuing systems.
* **Modern Web Ecosystems:** Strong understanding of frontend engineering paradigms, including component lifecycles, state management, and client\-side performance optimization.
* **Cloud \& DevOps Practice:** Hands\-on experience working with CI/CD automation pipelines, DevOps tooling, and cloud infrastructure platforms (AWS or GCP).
* **AI Tool Fluency:** Practical exposure and experience using generative AI tools to improve day\-to\-day coding efficiency and technical exploration.
* **Technical Communication:** Exceptional logical reasoning with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical thought processes and designs to both engineers and executives.

**Qualifications**

* **Professional Timeline:** 10\+ years of progressive software engineering experience building and scaling full\-stack applications in high\-growth product teams.
* **Iterative Sourcing History:** A proven track record of building complex systems from scratch and steering them through multiple scale iterations in production.
* **Pragmatic Delivery:** Skilled at balancing rapid feature delivery with long\-term code maintainability, clean documentation, and scalability.
* **Collaborative Leadership:** Experience managing technical initiatives, coordinating cross\-functional engineering loops, and mentoring other engineers.

Sanofi has currently the best and most robust pipeline of R\&D and consequent new launches of our history. jobs.description:
**Project Role :** Custom Software Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high\-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.
  

**Must have skills :** React.js  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **7\.5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

We are seeking an experienced software engineering professional to fulfill a technical engineering role. This position will contribute to and drive technical innovation, partner with cross\-team peers, influence and contribute to solution design and software delivery in a multi\-cloud environment.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

Develop and deliver high\-quality, customer\-facing user interface features within product teams using modern front\-end technologies  

Translate product requirements, UX designs, and technical specifications into performant, scalable, and maintainable UI components  

Build and maintain micro\-frontend\-based UI implementations aligned to product architecture  

Ensure all UI features adhere to accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) and deliver consistent, usable experiences  

Implement well\-structured, testable, and efficient code using TypeScript  

Own UI quality by developing and maintaining unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests  

Integrate UI components with backend services via REST APIs  

Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Backend Engineers to refine requirements and provide feedback on feasibility, usability, and technical approach  

Participate in agile ceremonies and contribute to iterative, predictable product delivery  

Conduct and participate in code reviews, enforcing best practices and improving overall code quality  

Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve UI defects across development, testing, and production environments  

Contribute to build, deployment, and release processes through CI/CD pipelines using GitHub\-based workflows

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**
* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.


 Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
   

  

 A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 This role is part of a broader enterprise initiative to establish a
 **Data Context Layer (DCL)** 
 — a foundational capability designed to provide consistent, reusable, and scalable context across enterprise data products.
   

  

 The DCL is intended to address challenges related to
 **data fragmentation, lack of shared semantics, and inconsistent interpretation of data across systems and products** 
 . It establishes a unified layer for representing context, relationships, and meaning, enabling downstream products to operate with greater consistency, interoperability, and intelligence.
   

  

 In addition, the DCL plays a critical role in enabling
 **agentic AI capabilities across the enterprise** 
 by providing the structured context and semantic grounding required for intelligent agents to operate reliably. This includes ensuring that agent\-driven workflows and decisions are based on
 **consistent, governed, and interpretable data context** 
 , reducing risks associated with fragmentation, ambiguity, and lack of control.
   

  

 Within this initiative, the Associate Director – Product Manager, Context Serving. will own the
 **product definition, development, and evolution of core context serving capabilities** 
 . These capabilities form the backbone for how context is consumed across multiple products and platforms, and will be central to enabling
 **governed, scalable, and reusable intelligent systems** 
 .
   

  

 The role operates at the intersection of
 **product, architecture, and enterprise platforms** 
 , working closely with Enterprise Architecture, platform teams, and product leadership to build
 **enterprise\-grade context capabilities that support both traditional data products and emerging AI\-driven use cases** 
 .
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a Product Manager to own a single, high\-impact capability within our enterprise data context platform
 **self\-service serving of standardized data context** 
 . This role will focus on defining, building, and scaling one core capability that enables teams to publish, discover, and consume data context consistently across the enterprise.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has strong product instincts, technical fluency in data/semantic systems, and experience partnering with engineering and architecture teams to deliver a platform capability from definition through production adoption. This role also requires working knowledge of
 **agentic AI, prompt engineering, and context engineering** 
 concepts, particularly as they relate to delivering reliable, reusable context for AI\-enabled applications.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the product vision, requirements, and roadmap for the assigned capability within the context platform.
* Define how the capability supports standardized, self\-service serving of data context.
* Partner with engineering, architecture, and governance teams to translate standards into implementable product requirements.
* Ensure the capability is intuitive for users and scalable for enterprise adoption.
* Define workflows for
+ publishing context
+ discovering context
+ consuming context through approved interfaces
+ validating and maintaining context quality

* Collaborate with adjacent platform teams to ensure the capability integrates cleanly with broader context, metadata, and governance services.
* Work with stakeholders to prioritize features, resolve tradeoffs, and drive adoption.
* Define success metrics such as usage, reuse, quality, and time\-to\-onboard.
* Support the transition of the capability from development into production, including release readiness, documentation, and operational requirements.
* Help shape how the capability supports agentic AI workflows, including reliable context delivery for prompts, tools, skills, and AI assistants.


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of product management experience in technical products, data platforms, or enterprise software.
* Ability to work closely with engineering teams on platform or infrastructure capabilities.
* Familiarity with data context, metadata, ontology, or semantic concepts.
* Working knowledge of agentic AI, prompt engineering, and context engineering concepts.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience defining requirements for self\-service or platform capabilities.

**About Gradera**
=================

  

Gradera defines a new category of enterprise transformation called Software\-Orchestrated Services \- where software orchestrates human expertise, digital workers, and enterprise systems to deliver governed outcomes at scale. As an AI Native Services firm, we help enterprises redesign how work gets done across operations, product, engineering, customer experience, data, and enterprise workflows to move beyond fragmented AI pilots and disconnected automation toward measurable business outcomes.

**About the Role**


We are looking for a hands\-on Scrum Master to support one or more engineering squads working on a complex, product\-grade platform. You will own agile ceremonies, protect the team's focus, and help build a delivery culture grounded in transparency and continuous improvement. This role suits someone who has moved past the basics and is comfortable navigating cross\-functional dependencies, distributed team dynamics, and evolving requirements.
  

  

**Our Agile Stack**

*Methodology*

* Scrum and Kanban for sprint and flow\-based delivery
* Familiarity with scaled frameworks (SAFe or LeSS) for multi\-team coordination
* Agile metrics: Velocity, Cycle Time, Throughput

*Tools*

* Jira and Confluence for backlog management, sprint tracking, and documentation
* Burndown/Burnup charts for delivery visibility
* Collaboration tools like Miro or Mural for remote retrospectives

*Stakeholder \& Planning*

* Sprint\-level capacity planning and dependency tracking
* Regular stakeholder updates translating team progress into delivery outcomes

**Key Responsibilities**

* Run effective sprint ceremonies — planning, standups, reviews, and retrospectives — with a focus on outcomes, not just process
* Spot and remove blockers early; escalate when needed without waiting for issues to compound
* Track and report velocity and burndown trends to help the team and leadership maintain realistic delivery forecasts
* Facilitate healthy team dynamics and help resolve interpersonal or cross\-functional friction when it arises
* Coordinate with other Scrum Masters and Tech Leads to manage dependencies across squads
* Maintain a clear backlog alongside the Product Owner, ensuring stories are well\-defined before sprint start
* Communicate progress and risks to stakeholders in plain language

**What We're Looking For**

* 8 \-10 years of overall professional experience, with at least 3 \- 4 years in a dedicated Scrum Master role
* Solid working knowledge of Jira/ADO/GitHub Projects and Confluence — you should be comfortable setting up boards, custom workflows, and basic reporting
* Experience working with or within a scaled agile environment (SAFe, LeSS, or similar)
* Comfortable working with senior engineers and tech leads without needing to manage every technical detail yourself
* Strong communication skills — written and verbal — especially in an offshore\-onsite model

**Good to Have**

* Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM I/II, or SAFe SSM)
* Prior experience in product engineering teams, ideally in industrial, logistics, or technology\-heavy domains
* Technical background (developer or SDET) that helps you engage meaningfully in engineering conversations
* Exposure to distributed or India\-US team structures

jobs.description:

 Headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany, Deutsche Börse Group is a leading international exchange organization and market infrastructure provider. They empower investors, financial institutions, and companies by facilitating access to global capital markets.
 



 Their India centre is located in Hyderabad, serves as a key strategic hub and comprises India’s top\-tier tech talent. They focus on crafting advanced IT solutions that elevate market infrastructure and services. Deutsche Börse Group in India is composed of a team of capital market engineers forming the backbone of financial markets worldwide.
 



  





**Field of activity:** 




 Corporate IT – together with the CTO Area \- is driving together the Implementation of ServiceNow for IT Service \& Asset Management. This is a multi\-year program professionalizing and standardizing the handling of CMDB, Asset Management, ITSM and other processes/activities. The IT SAM Program is pursuing a.o. following goals:
 


* Deliver a group wide IT Service \& Asset Management Platform in the cloud in line with the enterprise architecture
* Replace legacy technology (CRM7\) to Cloud native technology track
* Drive cultural change form proprietary DBG specific implementation into a SaaS solution



  





**Your Mission:** 




 We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Product Owner to set up and coordinate testing standards, activities and automation within the Implementation of ServiceNow for IT Service \& Asset Management to ensure the product is ready for end\-users.
 



 You will be at the heart of our digital transformation, driving the implementation and evolution of our new central platform. This is a key role in shifting our culture from a legacy, process\-heavy environment to a modern, cloud\-native, and service\-oriented model.
 



 The Test Manager will take responsibility in an interesting and dynamic, international environment. You will take part in the program as lead for testing in an international team (Frankfurt/Hyderabad), which enables integration of functional and technical requirements and improvements in a fast\-changing environment. The Test Manager contributes to the transformation into modern technologies and infrastructure in a highly regulated capital markets environment, advance innovation and contribute to Deutsche Börse Group’s overall strategy.
 



 If you are a practical leader who thinks in terms of products and services that deliver real value, and you are passionate about building modern IT solutions, this is the role for you. We need a doer, not just a theorist, who can cut through complexity and guide our organization towards a more efficient and user\-centric future.
 



  





**Your responsibilities:** 



* Define the standards for testing in the program, including the standard usage of the Automated Test Framework provided by ServiceNow.

* Provide test effort estimates and plan test activities in coordination with program management.

* Participate in documentation review sessions and evaluate specifications from a quality and testability perspective.
* Keep the Program Manager informed about the current state of quality and test progress, including identification and reporting of product risks.



  





**Your profile:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or equivalent experience.
* 6\+ years of experience in software testing of ITSM solutions, preferably ServiceNow
* Minimum 3 years in a Test Leader or similar senior testing role for ITSM solutions, preferably ServiceNow.
* Strong knowledge of testing best practices and tools.
* Hands\-on experience with SaaS platforms (preferably ServiceNow) and cloud platforms (preferably GCP)
* Proficient in test management and testing tools such as JIRA, Xray, SoapUI, and JMeter.
* Proficient in testing of CMDB, ITIL, ITSM and IT Access Management processes
* Experience with test automation frameworks, preferably the Automated Testing Framework of ServiceNow
* Comfortable operating at a senior level—managing stakeholder expectations and leading diverse testing teams.
* Solid understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).
* Detail\-oriented with a pragmatic approach to balancing quality and business constraints.
* Quick learner, able to comprehend unfamiliar codebases efficiently.
* Open\-minded, analytical, and solution oriented.
* Strong communication skills and experience working in international, cross\-country teams.
* Fluent in written and spoken English, basic knowledge of German would be beneficial



  





**Would be an advantage:** 



* ISTQB certification and proven experience leading QA teams under tight deadlines across the full testing lifecycle.
* Practical experience with SQL and relational databases.
* Familiarity with scripting or development in Java or Python.
* Good understanding of financial markets and regulations.

jobs.description:
**About The Role**
 The Global Senior Sales Solutions Manager (Pre\-Sales) plays a critical role executing high\-impact Uber Delivery wide digital led transformation initiative and continuously improving digital experience for our Commercial teams, and ensuring business values are delivered to the organization.
   

  

 You will work with cross\-functional leads from Business Stakeholders, Center of Excellence, Technical Solution Architect(s), Business Technology Engineering(IT), Analytics, Regional Ops, Change Management, to design, build, deploy the future state business capabilities in a continuous improvement motion.
   

  

 As a Senior Sales Solutions Manager, you will manage a team of 5\-6 Sales Solutions Manager. You will be responsible for translating business requirements into technical requirements, managing backlog, prioritizing features based on Commercial needs and business value, creating user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and measuring OKRs. You will be accountable to the success of each feature release from UAT, hypercare, and capturing the ongoing voice of customers.
   

  

 You should have a passion for efficiency and appreciate the need to create the best commercial user and customer experience. You should be comfortable in uncharted territory as we are embarking on this transformation journey, as Uber continues to rapidly innovate and usher in an era where Uber Delivery enables you to get anything. Uber Delivery needs your skills and passion to make it happen.
   

  

**What The Candidate Will Need / Bonus Points**
 \-\-\-\- What the Candidate Will Do \-\-\-\-
   

  

* Manage a team of 5\-6 Sales Solutions Manager on location
* Translate business requirements into technical requirements, managing backlog, prioritizing features based on Commercial needs and business value, creating user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and measuring OKRs
* You will be accountable to the success of each feature release end\-to\-end, from user stories creation, feature planning, UAT, hypercare support, and measuring business value delivered
* Ensuring that our suite of sales applications deliver business capabilities that meet the needs of our customers
* Gather, analyze feedback from different stakeholders, then create user stories, maintain backlog, plan and prioritize business capabilities development that align with business strategy
* Develop detailed product feature specifications and ensure they're clearly understood by relevant teams, develop feature\-release plans, and set expectations for delivery of new and/or updated features
* Participate in daily scrum meetings, sprint planning, and sprint reviews with the development team
* Create and maintain UAT library and prioritize defects
* Be a problem solver \- help identify problems as they arise, be able to lead and contribute to solutions to these problems, be they technical, process, and/or logistical
* Identify gaps or conflicts in requirements, handle risks \& UAT defects and drive toward resolution.
* Partner with Training and Enablement to ensure systems training content is accurate and its readiness
* Act as the primary point of contact for the development team and stakeholders regarding business application\-capabilities and related issues
* Have strong business acumen, serve as an ambassador to help drive future state process and tech adoption with our cross\-functional teams
* Develop thought partnership with BTE (aka IT) and Commercial leads, leveraging AI in combination of different business applications to help accelerate our digital transformation


**Basic Qualifications**
* Minimum 7\+ years as a Product Owner/Business Systems Analysts role for Salesforce or similar SaaS platforms as well as have worked with different teams across engineering, design and business in a complex organization matrix environment
* Minimum 3\+ years in management role
* Experience leading complex, large scale cross\-teams, cross\-functional initiatives that involved process improvements in sales, marketing, finance, operations for B2B
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills with track record of using objective data and metrics to back up assumptions, recommendations, and decisions
* Proficiency in SQL, JIRA, CPQ, Genesys Cloud, Dialpad, Groove and Salesforce, SaaS and or similar platforms
* Bachelors Degree Obtained


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with vendor management for both products and professional services areas \- preferred
* Experience as technical program management/project management
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills including ability to deliver program status, roadmaps, business outcomes \& impacts, and metrics
* Knowledge of Compliance (SOX, GDPR, PII), Scaled Agile Framework, Data Governance Framework
* Experience in User Experience design
* Experience in maintaining UAT library
* Certified SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager or Certified Scrum Product Owner \- preferred

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Tribute Technology is an established best\-in\-class Software as a Service technology company and solutions provider. Our customers include some of the largest and most prominent media brands in the world, spanning 4 continents and reaching millions of users every day. Our mission is to make meaningful connections between our customers and their users through innovation and a commitment to excellent user experience.
**ABOUT TRIBUTE TECHNOLOGY:**



At Tribute Technology, we make end\-of\-life celebrations memorable, meaningful, and effortless through thoughtful and innovative technology solutions. Our mission is to help communities around the world celebrate life and pay tribute to those we love. Our comprehensive platform brings together software and technology to provide a fully integrated experience for all users, whether that is a family, a funeral home, or an online publisher. We are the market leader in the US and Canada, with global expansion plans and a growing international team of more than 400 individuals in the US, Canada, Philippines, Ukraine and India.


**ABOUT YOU:**



This role is for a Senior Analytics professional who wants to go deep — not across many things, but into a specific domain of a complex eCommerce system and develop real expertise in how it works.



Tribute Technology operates a large, heterogeneous eCommerce portfolio across thousands of websites and multiple technology stacks. You will own a defined sub\-domain of that system — the conversion funnel, for example — and build a thorough understanding of every input that affects it, what normal performance looks like, and how the system responds when things change. The job is to surface intelligence, not to produce reports.



You need to bring meaningful eCommerce analytics experience to this role. The expectation is that you already understand how eCommerce performance works and can apply that understanding to a new and genuinely unusual context. You will work closely with the eCommerce Operations Team Lead and partner with the eCommerce and eCommerce Growth teams.


**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**


* **Own your domain:**  

	+ Develop deep expertise in an assigned sub\-domain of Tribute's eCommerce system — understand all the inputs that affect performance, how they interact, and what drives outcomes.
	+ Build and maintain baseline models: given observable inputs, what should performance look like? Identify where the system is over\- or underperforming, and why.
	+ Maintain a forward\-looking view of performance in your domain — surface anomalies and emerging trends before they appear in top\-line metrics.
* **Measure what changes:**
  

	+ When changes are made — product updates, platform changes, configuration adjustments — measure how your domain responds and communicate clearly what happened.
	+ Distinguish deliberate change effects from background variation and portfolio mix shifts. Be precise about what the data supports.
	+ Monitor how the system responds to initiatives run by the eCommerce Growth team; provide clean measurement of outcomes within your domain.
	+ Maintain a record of changes, system responses, and learnings over time.
* **Analysis and tooling:**  

	+ Write and maintain SQL across BigQuery and Athena for both recurring analytical work and ad hoc investigation.
	+ Build and maintain reports and dashboards in Power BI and Looker/Looker Studio that surface performance intelligence.
	+ Work within GA4 for behavioral and funnel analysis — event model, path analysis, custom dimensions.
	+ Identify data quality issues in your domain; partner with data engineering to resolve them and distinguish data artifacts from genuine business signals.

**EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:**



* **Experience:**  

	+ 7\+ years of hands\-on eCommerce or digital analytics experience.
	+ Track record of going genuinely deep in a specific analytical domain — not broad coverage, but real expertise in how a part of a system works.
	+ Experience working with complex, multi\-source data environments and drawing coherent conclusions across platforms.
	+ Exposure to high\-volume portfolio analytics where aggregate pattern recognition matters more than individual\-unit analysis.
	+ Short\-lifecycle or event\-driven eCommerce experience is a plus.
* **Domain knowledge \& curiosity:**
	+ Solid understanding of eCommerce mechanics — how the funnel works, what drives conversion, how traffic quality and site configuration affect outcomes.
	+ Genuine curiosity about the system behind the numbers; you want to understand why something is happening, not just measure that it is.
	+ Ability to connect analytical findings to business outcomes — you understand what a metric means, not just how to compute it.
	+ Exposure to payments, multi\-platform eCommerce, or A/B testing environments is a plus.
* **Technical Skills:**  

	+ SQL — intermediate to advanced, in BigQuery and/or Athena; window functions, CTEs, complex aggregations.
	+ Google Analytics 4 — event model, funnel and path analysis, exploration reports, custom dimensions.
	+ Statistical fundamentals — baseline modeling, anomaly detection, understanding of variance and signal\-to\-noise in high\-volume data.
	+ Power BI — building and maintaining reports; DAX measure creation.
	+ Looker / LookML — exploring data and working within existing models.
	+ Looker Studio — dashboard creation, blended data sources.
	+ Python or R for statistical modeling and ad hoc analysis — strongly preferred.
* **How you work:**  

	+ Clear communicator in English — written and verbal; able to translate analytical findings into plain business language.
	+ High ownership; proactive and self\-directed without needing to be tasked.
	+ Rigorous — precise about the limits of what you can claim, and honest when the data is inconclusive.
	+ Effective in a distributed, cross\-functional team.
* **Education:**  

	+ Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field — Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economi…

jobs.description:

-----------------



We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst cum Project Manager with a strong background in managing AI and Digital Transformation initiatives. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams, driving the successful delivery of AI\-powered solutions from ideation through implementation.

jobs.title: Specialist Assistant Manager - Talent Business Analyst (Consulting) - Hyderabad
jobs.description:
**Specialist Assistant Manager, Analytics and Insights (Consulting Services – Supporting US)**


At Deloitte, the Business Advisor team partners with the business leaders of a function or service to craft, execute and drive the delivery of the firm’s Talent strategy. You will play a key role in helping the business drive performance, develop talent and retain key talent. This role will focus primarily on RRWB support, with additional activities related to supporting the Talent life cycle processes in the business. You are expected to work with the business to drive solutions to core business problems from a Talent standpoint.

**Work you'll do**


As a Specialist Assistant Manager, Analytics and Insights (Consulting Services – Supporting US) on the Business Advisory team, you will be responsible for supporting business leaders with talent insights, workforce planning, and talent strategy execution.

* Support the annual compensation cycle by inputting and updating data, preparing reports, maintaining trackers, validating data, and coordinating process activities to help ensure timely and accurate completion of compensation planning deliverables.
* Support execution of targeted compensation activities, including off\-cycle adjustments, Reward Excellence processes, and associated reporting, tracking, coordination, and follow\-up activities.
* Collaborate with the compensation team and business partners to gather inputs and support consistent execution of compensation and talent\-related activities, including ad hoc support for talent processes.
* Analyze attrition, engagement, survey, and workforce data to identify trends, root causes, and actions that support business priorities.
* Evaluate talent programs and processes, identify improvement opportunities, and support implementation of new initiatives and cross\-functional projects.
* Develop reports, metrics, and insights to support headcount forecasting, skill planning, and talent decisions across assigned FSS groups.

**The team**


Our Talent team offers HR solutions by tapping into the different aspects of HR policies, to ensure every professional’s engagement with the organization is meaningful. It is structured into five major organizations: Talent Acquisition, Talent Delivery, Talent Development, Talent Specialties and Talent Operations.


As part of the Business Advisory team, you will work with our business leaders, foster change throughout the organization and ensure that Talent strategies are aligned with the firm’s culture.

**Location: Hyderabad**

**Shift Timings: 2 PM to 11 PM**

**Qualifications**


Required:

* MBA or equivalent degree
* 6\-9 years of experience in human resources, talent advisory, workforce planning, talent analytics, or human resources business partnering
* Experience analyzing workforce, attrition, engagement, or survey data using reporting or analytics tools
* Experience supporting business leaders in a matrixed organization
* Experience partnering with Talent Acquisition, Talent Development, Total Rewards, or Deployment stakeholders


Preferred:

* Society for Human Resource Management (SHRM), Professional in Human Resources (PHR), or Senior Professional in Human Resources (SPHR) certification
* Experience supporting performance management, succession planning, compensation planning, or workforce planning activities
* Experience creating executive\-ready dashboards, reports, or presentations
* Experience leading process improvement or cross\-functional initiatives
* Experience supporting US stakeholders or global teams


**Our purpose**  


Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon's Verification \& Risk Management Operations (VRMO) mission is to make Amazon the safest and most trusted place worldwide to transact online, either by identifying and reporting bad actors or mitigating risk and adhering to compliance laws and regulations according to market\-specific, regional, or global direction. Amazon runs one of the most dynamic online platforms, encompassing dozens of global products with compliance requirements, including, Amazon Marketplace with over 2 million sellers worldwide selling hundreds of millions of items in eleven countries, Amazon Pay and MTurk.  

  

VRMO designs and builds the software systems, risk models and operational processes that minimise risk and maximise trust across Amazon's global product surface area, by ensuring every transaction and entity is compliant.  

  

We are looking for a highly analytical and result\-oriented Business Analyst who can analyse business decisions, troubleshoot issues, and communicate the findings effectively across different teams while raising the technical bar of the globally distributed analytics team, providing data wrangling expertise, deep understanding of data fundamentals, working with and synthesising very large datasets.  

  

We utilise multiple externally and internally (AWS and other) developed data platforms, including real\-time and close to real\-time platforms, to help create signal out of the mountains of data.  

  

Our ideal analyst is one who enjoys discovering and solving complicated problems, can quickly learn complex systems, likes to work with numbers, and takes pride in organising and communicating his work. You should have the technical experience and knowledge to work comfortably using SQL, QuickSight/Tableau/PowerBI and scripting languages (Python/JavaScript) Additionally experience with designing data schemas that will allow you, and colleagues, which include Business Intelligence Engineers and Data Engineers to make sense of the vast datasets we possess.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Organisation skills – demonstrated ability to work independently to make complex investigations, has self\-discipline, is diligent and can manage time appropriately.
* Communication skills – ability to communicate (written and spoken) in English. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical problems in simple plain stories
* Automation of manual data processes, including data quality and validation
* Reporting using widely available reporting tools, for instance Quicksight or Tableau
* Ability to translate ambiguous work\-streams in to tangible requirements, and success metrics, including ability to build metrics and metrics decks.
* Ability to earn trust among widely differing stakeholders of different roles, responsibilities, geographical location, and, culture.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of business or financial analysis experience
* Experience gathering business requirements, using industry standard business intelligence tool(s) to extract data, formulate metrics and build reports
* Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders
* 1\+ years of relational database technology (such as Redshift, Oracle, MySQL or MS SQL) experience
* • Familiarity with optimization, planning and logistics concepts – gained through work experience or education.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in managing and troublshooting network
* Experience with SQL and database technologies such as AWS Redshift and expertise in performance tuning and scaling in a DWH environment
* Knowledge of at least one data visualization product (Tableau, Looker, Amazon QuickSight, etc.)
* Experience working in a matrixed environment, influencing strategy, and achieving goals by working across the organization
* Experience with automation or working with scripting languages like Python, Java, Perl, PHP, Ruby, Bash, Shell, or equivalent
* Master's degree or equivalent in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data\-driven business decisions

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.description:
Dreaming big is in our DNA. It’s who we are as a company. It’s our culture. It’s our heritage. And more than ever, it’s our future. A future where we’re always looking forward. Always serving up new ways to meet life’s moments. A future where we keep dreaming bigger. We look for people with passion, talent, and curiosity, and provide them with the teammates, resources, and opportunities to unleash their full potential. The power we create together \- when we combine your strengths with ours \- is unstoppable. Are you ready to join a team that dreams as big as you do?
 



  





 AB InBev Analytics CoE, GAC, is a part of Anheuser\-Busch InBev and leads the cutting\-edge AI, Analytics, Technology solutions \& products for the company. The center leverages the power of data and analytics to drive growth for critical business functions such as Revenue Management, Marketing, Strategy, Sales etc.

**Job Title: Associate Product Manager** 




**Location: Bangalore (Onsite)** 




  





**PURPOSE OF ROLE** 




 The Global GenAI Team at Anheuser\-Busch InBev (AB InBev) is tasked with building transformational products using Generative AI that enable us to drive productivity gains and efficiencies.
 



 We build high value products such as AB InBev’s in\-house intelligence engine which aims to extract contextual insights and meaningful information from our enterprise data based on natural language queries. The derived data\-driven insights are integrated in various business products in AB InBev and play a pivotal role in empowering our business users to make well\-informed decisions regarding their respective domains. One such integration is an iOS app built for the CEO and executive audiences delivering real\-time financial performance, daily sales, and business critical signals and enhanced by AI.

 • Own features end\-to\-end: Translate user and business needs into scoped requirements, write clear specs and acceptance criteria, and drive features from discovery through release. Operate across the full product surface (mobile \+ web) and keep delivery on track.

 And above all of this, an undying love for beer!
 



 We dream big to create a future with more cheers.

jobs.title: Product Manager 2 - Operations Excellence
jobs.description:
At Cult.fit, we believe a perfect workout starts long before the first rep. The Operations Excellence team is the invisible force that makes this happen — ensuring every one of our 700\+ fitness centers delivers a flawless, consistent member experience, every single day, at scale.
 



  





 We build the technology that empowers thousands of frontline peers — trainers, center managers, housekeeping staff, and gym owners — and gives central governance teams real\-time visibility into what's happening on the ground. Think IoT sensors that measure center health, vision\-tech that analyzes CCTV feeds to flag experience issues without human intervention, and workflow automation systems that orchestrate actions across the organization before a single member notices a problem.
 



  





 This is high\-impact, high\-visibility work. The products you build will be used by thousands of Cult.fit employees daily and will directly protect the workout experience of millions of members.
 



  





 We are looking for a Product Manager 2 to own and advance the operations excellence charter. You will be the connective tissue between frontline operations, central governance, process design, engineering, analytics, and UX — translating on\-ground realities into scalable, intuitive technology solutions. You will work with ambiguous, complex operational problems and drive them to crisp, well\-defined product solutions with measurable impact.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 



* Define and drive the product roadmap for operations excellence — building tools that help frontline staff do their best work and giving management teams real\-time visibility into center health.
* Conduct deep user research with diverse stakeholders — from housekeeping staff at a Bengaluru center to senior operations leaders — to understand their workflows, pain points, and what "excellent" looks like in practice.
* Work with engineering teams to build and scale IoT and vision\-tech integrations that enable continuous, automated measurement of center experience.
* Design and iterate on workflow management and automation systems that surface the right information to the right person at the right time — reducing operational toil and increasing accountability.
* Translate operational complexity into clean, intuitive product experiences — the trainer using your app in a 5\-minute window between sessions needs it to be fast and effortless.
* Establish the right metrics to measure center experience quality, identify leading indicators, and use data to rigorously validate product decisions and prioritize the highest\-leverage interventions.
* Run rapid experiments, test hypotheses, and iterate fast — this is a domain where the feedback loop between product and ground reality is tight.
* Partner closely with process design teams to ensure that product changes and operational processes reinforce each other.



  





**What We're Looking For:** 




  




* 3\+ years of experience in product management, ideally within consumer or enterprise applications where operational complexity meets user empathy.
* A bachelor's or master's degree from a highly regarded institution (Tier 1 preferred).
* Strong data orientation — you can define the right metrics for a complex operational problem, identify proxies when perfect data doesn't exist, and use quantitative and qualitative signals together to arrive at sharp insights.
* Demonstrated ability to break down complex, ambiguous problems into structured, actionable product roadmaps. You can articulate a problem crisply in a sentence, and back it up with conviction.
* Ability to work with large, diverse stakeholder groups — including non\-technical frontline users — and the ability to adapt your communication and product decisions to their needs.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Auric AI** 




 Auric AI is developing the world's most advanced AI\-powered vision intelligence platform for defense applications
 



 Defense and military organizations today receive overwhelming volumes of visual data from satellites and drones. Processing this manually is slow, expensive, and error\-prone. Our mission is to use AI\-powered vision systems to detect and classify high\-value military objects such as tanks, artillery, radars, and missile launchers so analysts and commanders can act faster and with greater confidence.
 



  





 We’re a fast\-moving defense technology startup, combining world\-class AI research with real\-world military applications to create intelligence platforms that can make a difference where time and trust matter most.
 



**The Role** 




 We’re hiring a Product Manager to lead the development of our Vision Intelligence Platform.
 



 This is not a traditional PM role. You will:
 


* Think from first principles to design workflows that make AI useful in mission\-critical contexts.
* Translate AI research into usable, analyst\-facing products.
* Balance speed, trust, and usability when making product decisions.
* Be AI\-native using the latest AI tools to build wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and demo flows at speed.
* You will own the end\-to\-end product experience: defining workflows, designing intuitive screens, prioritizing features, and ensuring analysts receive intelligence they can trust all within minutes of image arrival.



**What You’ll Do** 



* Vision \& Roadmap


1. Define the product vision and articulate a clear north star for the platform.
2. Build and communicate a roadmap balancing near\-term MVP delivery with long\-term platform growth.


* Workflow \& UX Design


1. Map the full analyst journey: image ingestion → preprocessing → AI detection → quality review → database → dissemination.
2. Work with engineers and designers to create intuitive, analyst\-ready screens.
3. Use AI\-powered tools (e.g., Figma plugins, AI prototyping, AI design assistants) to generate wireframes and demo flows rapidly.


* Feature Prioritization


1. Define MVP scope and ruthlessly separate must\-haves from nice\-to\-haves.
2. Make trade\-offs between speed\-to\-decision, detection accuracy, and user trust.


* Execution \& Delivery


1. Translate requirements into clear PRDs and product specs.
2. Drive collaboration between AI researchers, engineers, and domain experts.
3. Ensure reliability and quality in product releases.


* User \& Stakeholder Engagement


1. Engage with analysts, retired officers, and other stakeholders to understand workflows.
2. Synthesize fragmented feedback into coherent product direction.


* Metrics \& Success


1. Define and track success metrics: time\-to\-insight, adoption, accuracy, and trust in outputs.
2. Use feedback and data to iterate rapidly.



**What We’re Looking For** 



* AI\-native builder: highly proficient in using AI tools for prototyping, wireframing, and creating demo flows.
* First principles thinker who simplifies complex problems into clear workflows.
* Technical fluency: understand how AI and software systems work, even if you don’t code daily.
* User empathy: can design for non\-technical users working under pressure.
* Execution strength: bias for rapid prototyping, iteration, and delivery.
* Communication skills: able to align researchers, engineers, and defense users.
* Prior startup/founder experience or exposure to AI/ML products is a strong plus.



**Why Join Us** 



* Work on one of the hardest, most impactful problems in defense AI.
* Collaborate with a small, world\-class team of researchers and engineers.
* High ownership from day one shapes the platform, not just maintains it.
* Move fast, learn fast, we build, test, and iterate aggressively.
* Be part of a mission\-driven company where AI meets national security.



 Auric AI is building the future of defense intelligence. If you’re an AI\-native product builder who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer II (AI/ML)
jobs.description:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast\-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you'll find your place here. We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world.

**Position Overview**
---------------------


* We are looking for a **Senior Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE)** who is passionate about operationalizing production AI\-native and agentic workloads at scale. This is a high\-impact role designed to serve as the "technical tip of the spear" for DigitalOcean's most strategic AI\-native customers and platform initiatives.
* As an FDE, you will operate at the intersection of Product Engineering, AI Infrastructure, and Customer Implementation. You will partner deeply with strategic AI\-native enterprises (ANEs), startups, infrastructure vendors, and internal engineering teams to deploy, optimize, and scale production AI systems on DigitalOcean's AI\-Native Cloud.
* This role extends beyond traditional GPU infrastructure deployment. You will work across Inference Engine, runtime systems, orchestration frameworks, and AI\-native applications to help customers operationalize production AI and agentic systems with strong focus on scalability, reliability, latency, and workload economics.
* FDE engineers also act as the "first customer" for new AI\-native platform capabilities. You will validate products under real\-world workloads, surface operational insights and architectural gaps, and help accelerate product maturity through continuous feedback loops with Product Engineering and Research teams.
* You will build scalable deployment frameworks, benchmarking systems, automation tooling, and AI starter kits that transform field learning into reusable platform intelligence and repeatable deployment patterns across the DigitalOcean ecosystem.
* Your mission is to accelerate production adoption of AI\-native systems while helping shape the future of DigitalOcean's AI\-Native Cloud for the inference and agentic era.

**What You'll Do**
------------------



Strategic AI Workload Operationalization: Partner with strategic ANEs and AI startups to architect, deploy, optimize, and scale production AI and agentic systems on DigitalOcean's AI\-Native Cloud. Support complex migrations, production\-ready PoCs, deployment acceleration, and long\-term workload expansion across inference and runtime platforms.AI Performance \& Systems Engineering: Optimize distributed inference and runtime performance through benchmarking, GPU efficiency tuning, KV\-cache optimization, speculative decoding, prefill/decode disaggregation, multi\-node deployments, and latency/cost optimization.Platform Validation \& Product Acceleration: Act as the "first customer" for DigitalOcean's AI\-native platform capabilities including Inference Engine, runtimes, orchestration systems, GPU platforms, and deployment workflows. Surface real\-world operational insights, architectural gaps, and scaling bottlenecks directly to Product Engineering and Research teams.Platform Intelligence \& Automation: Build scalable deployment assets including benchmarking systems, automation tooling, AI starter kits, deployment frameworks, operational playbooks, finetuning workflows, and reference architectures that improve deployment velocity and platform adoption.Ecosystem \& Technical Enablement: Collaborate with GPU vendors, model providers, infrastructure partners, and ISVs on co\-development, technical validation, optimization, and launch readiness. Enable customer\-facing technical teams and partner teams through validated deployment patterns, benchmarking insights, operational playbooks, reference architectures, demos, and technical guidance that help scale adoption of DigitalOcean's AI\-native platform.Travel \& Collaboration Requirements: Ability to travel up to 30% for customer engagements, strategic workshops, conferences, and internal collaboration. Ability to consistently overlap with North American business hours, including availability until at least noon Eastern Time, to collaborate effectively with customers, Product, Engineering, and go\-to\-market teams.


**Key Metrics**
---------------



Customer Adoption \& Production Success: Measured by high\-impact production workloads launched, reduction in time\-to\-production, pilot\-to\-production conversion rates, and expansion of AI\-native platform adoption across strategic customers.Platform Intelligence \& Product Influence: Measured by product improvements, roadmap influence, validated customer hypotheses, and operational insights generated from real\-world production deployments.Asset \& Tooling Delivery: Measured through adoption of FDE\-built frameworks, automation tooling, benchmarking systems, operational playbooks, and reference architectures across customers and internal teams.Field Enablement \& Ecosystem Scale: Measured through successful enablement of customer\-facing teams, ecosystem collaboration outcomes, and adoption of FDE deployment standards across the AI\-native ecosystem.


**What You'll Add to DigitalOcean**
-----------------------------------



AI\-Native Systems \& Architecture Expertise: Experience designing and operationalizing production AI systems including inference workloads, agentic runtimes, orchestration frameworks, and AI\-native applications. Strong hands\-on experience with inference and serving frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, Ray Serve, NVIDIA Dynamo, llm\-d, or equivalent systems, along with LLM optimization techniques including continuous batching, quantization, KV\-cache optimization, and speculative decoding.Distributed Systems \& Infrastructure Mastery: Deep expertise with NVIDIA and AMD GPU platforms and their softw…

Candidate Profile

We are trusted by clients across all major sectors, from up\-and\-coming success stories to iconic Fortune Global 500 brands in over 70 countries spanning 6 continents.
 



  





 Our game\-changers:
 



  





 \* Challenge Conventions
 



  





 \* Deliver outcomes unimagined
 



  





 \* Create experiences that go beyond WOW
 



  





 If this is you, we would love to discuss career opportunities with you.
 



  





 In our Information Technology and Global Security team, you will deliver the latest technology infrastructure, transformative software solutions and industry\-leading global security for our staff and clients. You will work with the best in the world to design, implement and strategize IT, security, application development, innovation, and solutions in today’s hyperconnected world. You will be part of the technology team that is core to our vision of develop, build and run the future of CX.
 



  





 Concentrix provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in many benefit programs, generally including private medical plans, great compensation package, retirement savings plans, paid learning days, and flexible workplaces. Specific benefits plans will vary by country/region.
 



  





 We’re a remote\-first company looking for the absolute best talent in the world. Experience the power of a game\-changing career.
 



  





 Position: Objective: Staff Technical Product Owner
 



 Location: Bangalore
 



  





 The Staff Technical Product Owner works to fulfill the strategic product direction established by the Engineering, Architecture, and Product Management teams. This role is responsible for defining the detailed requirements for each product and feature. The Staff Technical Product Manager must have a firm understanding of the business domain and project needs considering multiple types of users utilizing each solution. This position works closely with engineering on the specifications to ensure their Agile team has all the information needed to deliver a complete product to market. As a Data and Analytics Product Owner, you will be responsible for driving the development and delivery of data products, analytics solutions, and ensuring they align with business objectives.
 



  





 Duties and Responsibilities:
 



  





 • Bridge business requirements to technical capabilities
 



 • Translate product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes.
 



 • Work with the Product Manager and Agile team to define the scope included in a release.
 



 • Work with Product Owners to develop detailed specifications/requirements for the product features so they are clearly understood by the development team.
 



 • Actively participate in PI planning, product sprints and daily stand\-up meetings
 



 • Be aware of customer commitments to communicate internally to assist with managing team expectations.
 



 • Manage dependencies in and across sprints and releases.
 



 • Work with the Agile team to manage and prioritize the backlog to ensure alignment with changing business needs.
 



 • Prioritize support work as needed.
 



 • Keep stakeholders apprised of progress and incorporate their feedback.
 



 • Use metrics and feedback to improve team and organization processes, best practices, performance, and delivery.
 



 • Leverage technical knowledge to make informed decisions about product architecture, scalability, and performance. Assess and address technical risks.
 



 • Act as a technology champion within the company.
 



 • Collaborate on Technology Roadmap with Product Manager and Architects
 



 • Stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data analytics and AI.
 



  





 Qualifications Required:
 



  





 • Overall 9\+ years of experience in software development.
 



 • Bachelor’s degree in data science, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
 



 • Minimum of 3 years of experience in a Product Owner, Data Analyst, or similar role within the data and analytics domain.
 



 • He/She should have understanding about Data Engineering (if possible AI) and have worked with those teams atleast 1 year.
 



 • Experience working on these Tech Stack \- AWS Data and Analytics \- Data Lakes and Analytics on AWS \- Amazon Web Services (this page has section of all services that are part of AWS Data and Analytics) \- Specifically we are using Amazon S3, Glue, Lambda, SQS, Amazon Redshift, Athena, StepFn and basic services like IAM and VPC is must.
 



 • Strong understanding of data analytics tools and technologies (e.g., SQL, Python, R, Tableau, Power BI).
 



 • Having working knowledge of API Platform Technologies, Database, Microsoft Development Technologies
 



 • Experience building SaaS, Mobile, Data and AI solutions.
 



 • Experience with data warehousing, data modeling, and ETL processes.
 



 • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
 



 • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously.
 



 • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and product management tools (e.g., Aha, ADO,etc.)
 



  





 Personal Attributes:
 



  





 • Analytical mindset with strong problem\-solving skills.
 



 • Detail\-oriented with a commitment to data quality and accuracy.
 



 • Self\-motivated and able to work independently.
 



 • Collaborative and team\-oriented with a strong focus on stakeholder satisfaction.

**Role:** 
**Data Product Owner**
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad / Bangalore
   

  

**Full/ Part\-time:**

**Build a career with confidence**
 Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world\-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Data Product Owner – Truck \& Trailer IoT supports the definition and delivery of IoT‑enabled data products focused on connected trucks, trailers, and mobile assets. These data products enable fleet operations, asset visibility, maintenance insights, safety, and lifecycle analytics for truck and trailer businesses.
   

  

 This role works closely with fleet operations, telematics teams, aftermarket/service teams, data engineers, and platform teams to translate vehicle and trailer telemetry data into trusted, reusable data products that support analytics, reporting, and future AI/ML use cases.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for someone early in their career who wants to build a product mindset at the intersection of IoT, mobility, and data analytics.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Truck \& Trailer IoT Data Product Definition
* Support definition of IoT‑driven data products related to trucks, trailers, and mobile assets, such as:
* Vehicle and trailer location, movement, and utilization
* Telematics signals (GPS, temperature, door events, idle time)
* Asset health, fault codes, and maintenance indicators
* Cold‑chain and cargo condition monitoring (where applicable)
* Assist in capturing business requirements, KPIs, and use cases from fleet, service, and operations stakeholders.
* Help document data product scope, objectives, and success metrics aligned to enterprise data product standards.
* Truck \& Trailer Business Domain Collaboration
* Work with fleet operations, service, aftermarket, and IoT/telematics teams to understand how trucks and trailers are used in real‑world operations.
* Develop familiarity with truck and trailer business concepts, including:
* Fleet utilization and uptime
* Preventive and predictive maintenance
* Asset lifecycle and warranty considerations
* Safety, compliance, and regulatory reporting
* Act as a bridge between business users and technical teams, ensuring shared understanding of requirements and outcomes.
* Delivery \& Execution Support
* Partner with data engineers to support delivery of streaming and near‑real‑time IoT data products sourced from telematics platforms.
* Support agile ceremonies (backlog refinement, sprint reviews, demos) and track progress of data product delivery.
* Validate delivered datasets against business definitions, freshness expectations, and usability needs before release.
* 4\. Data Quality, Governance \& Context for Telematics Data
* Help define basic data quality expectations for vehicle and trailer telemetry (e.g., timeliness, completeness, signal consistency).
* Support documentation of business meaning and operational context for IoT signals (what the data represents and how it should be interpreted).
* Ensure data products follow established metadata, ownership, and governance standards.
* Stakeholder Communication \& Adoption
* Support communication with stakeholders on data product scope, delivery timelines, and usage guidance.
* Assist in onboarding analysts, operations users, and service teams to truck and trailer IoT data products.
* Gather user feedback to improve clarity, usability, and business value of data products.


**Required Qualifications**
* 2 to 6 years of experience in a business analyst, product analyst, data analyst, or junior product role.
* Basic understanding of data, analytics, and KPIs.
* Interest in IoT, telematics, fleet management, or mobility solutions.
* Strong communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to collaborate with cross‑functional teams in an agile environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Exposure to truck, trailer, or fleet‑related data (telematics, GPS, sensors, service data).
* Familiarity with IoT or telematics platforms and event‑based / time‑series data.
* Understanding of fleet KPIs such as utilization, uptime, dwell time, MTBF/MTTR, or cold‑chain compliance.
* Experience supporting dashboards or operational reporting.
* Curiosity to learn streaming data pipelines and IoT architectures.


**Benefits**
 We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees and enhancing our programs when necessary.
   

  

* Enjoy your best years with our retirement savings plan
* Have peace of mind and body with our health insurance
* Make yourself a priority with flexible schedules, parental leave and our holiday purchase scheme
* Drive forward your career through professional development opportunities
* Achieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance Programme.


**Our commitment to you**
 Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best\-in\-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is

Our Diligent One Platform gives practitioners, the C\-Suite, and the board a consolidated view of their entire GRC practice, so they can manage risk, build resilience, and make better decisions, faster.
   

  

 We pioneered the modern governance movement and we are now leading its AI transformation. Curiosity is in our DNA. We look for people who ask the big questions, experiment fearlessly, and see change as opportunity.

jobs.description:
**Dyson IT**
 At Dyson, we demand the highest performance standards from the technologies we engineer. Our people expect the same from the technology that supports them.
   

  

 Global IT plays a critical role in enabling Dyson’s engineering teams to deliver world class innovation through scalable, reliable, and forward\-thinking digital platforms.
   

  

**Our RDD IT Team**
 The RDD IT function has end\-to\-end accountability for the design, delivery, and support of the systems that enable Dyson’s global research, engineering, and product development communities.
   

  

**This Includes**
* Engineering platforms such as PLM (Teamcenter), CAE, simulation, and digital engineering tooling
* Global product development systems and processes
* Delivery of transformation initiatives and operational IT services across multiple global sites


**The Role**
 The Technical Product Manager – PLM is responsible for defining, owning, and evolving technical products within the RDD IT landscape, with a particular focus on the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) stack.
   

  

 Operating within the RDD IT function, this role ensures that PLM product roadmaps are aligned to engineering needs and business priorities, translating complex requirements into structured plans for delivery. You will act as a key interface between engineering stakeholders, solution architects, and delivery teams, ensuring that solutions are robust, scalable, and aligned to industry best practices.
   

  

 You will work closely with internal teams and external partners to oversee the quality of delivery, drive continuous improvement across product and application lifecycles, and contribute to the long\-term evolution of Dyson’s engineering technology landscape.
   

  

**Principal Accountabilities**
 Product Strategy \& Roadmap
   

  

* Create and maintain an IT product development roadmap for PLM (Teamcenter) capabilities
* Ensure roadmaps reflect technical thought leadership and industry best practices
* Align product direction to engineering requirements and business priorities
* Continuously review and refine roadmap based on stakeholder input and delivery outcomes


 Stakeholder Management \& Business Partnership
   

  

* Act as an ambassador for Global IT across RDD and NPI stakeholder groups
* Engage with senior RDD stakeholders, engineers, solution architects, and business process owners
* Build strong working relationships across delivery, support, and engineering teams
* Ensure alignment between stakeholder needs and product direction


 Delivery Oversight \& Quality Assurance
   

  

* Work within the RDD IT delivery function to oversee quality of technical delivery
* Ensure solutions comply with defined standards, policies, and architectural direction
* Collaborate with delivery teams and external partners to ensure successful execution
* Support resolution of delivery challenges and ensure continuous improvement


 Platform Ownership \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Take joint accountability for the robustness and maturity of PLM platforms
* Support and improve product management and application delivery practices
* Identify opportunities to enhance system capabilities and user experience
* Drive continuous improvement across product lifecycle and service delivery


 Vendor \& Partner Management
   

  

* Work with external strategic partners to bring industry insight and best practice
* Collaborate with Legal and Procurement to maximise value from third\-party engagements
* Support development of long\-term platform capability and vendor strategy


 Technology Strategy \& Innovation
   

  

* Support architecture teams and strategic partners in shaping future platform direction
* Contribute to adoption of new technologies and industry trends within RDD IT
* Identify opportunities to improve capability through innovation and tooling evolution


 Professional Development
   

  

* Own and drive personal and professional development in line with Dyson frameworks
* Use internal development tools to assess capability and define growth objectives
* Continuously build technical and stakeholder management expertise


**Person Specification / Core Competencies**
 You must possess strong technical product management capability, with the ability to bridge engineering needs and IT delivery. You will demonstrate strong organisational skills, stakeholder engagement, and the ability to manage complexity in a fast\-paced engineering environment.
   

  

 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strong product management capability within technical or engineering environments
* Ability to translate complex requirements into structured product roadmaps
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
* Ability to prioritise and manage competing demands at pace
* Strong organisational and delivery focus


**Essential**
* Experience managing technical products within engineering or R\&D environments
* Strong experience with PLM platforms, particularly Siemens Teamcenter
* Experience managing change and enhancement within large\-scale engineering systems
* Experience working across delivery teams, architects, and business stakeholders
* Experience contributing to technical strategy and product direction


 Desirable
   

  

* Experience working within global, matrixed organisations
* Experience collaborating with external partners and vendors
* Exposure to engineering toolchains including simulation, CAE, or software development platforms
